mapper.sql: id, period_code, contract_code, client_code, business_code, org_id, bill_contract_code, currency_code, account_code, account_name, year_begin_debit_balance, year_begin_credit_balance, month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, month_end_debit_balance, month_end_credit_balance, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag

with sub as(
select string_agg(ev.id ::text, ',') voucher_ids , ev.period_code, eve.account_code , --科目编码 eve.account_name , --科目名称
eve.contract_code, --合同编码 eve.contract_name, ---合同名字 是否需要关联 eve.client_code, --客户编码
ev.business_code, --业务类型 ev.currency , --增加一个币种 to_char(ev.voucher_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') voucher_date, --记账日期 ev.org_id, --改成名称 sum(eve.debit_amount) debit_amount, --借方 sum(eve.credit_amount) credit_amount ---贷方 from eg_voucher_entry eve join eg_voucher ev on eve.voucher_id = ev.id and ev.period_code = eve.period_code where 1=1 and ev.period_code = ${item} --期间参数 and ev.org_id=#{param.orgId} --机构参数 and eve.account_code=#{param.accountCode} --科目参数
and eve.contract_code=#{param.contractCode} --合同参数
group by eve.account_code , --科目编码 eve.account_name , --科目名称
eve.contract_code, --合同编码 eve.contract_name, ---合同名字 是否需要关联 eve.client_code, --客户编码
ev.business_code, --业务类型 ev.currency, --增加一个币种 to_char(ev.voucher_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), --记账日期 ev.period_code, ev.org_id --改成名称
)
mapper.select:
select res.*,#{param.periodCodeStart} period_code_start,#{param.periodCodeEnd} period_code_end from res
limit #{param.limit} offset #{param.offset}

select res.*,#{param.periodCodeStart} period_code_start,#{param.periodCodeEnd} period_code_end from res
limit #{param.limit} offset #{param.offset}

select * from res_account order by account_code
limit #{param.limit} offset #{param.offset}
mapper.sql:
,res_voucher as( select ev_eve.org_id ,ev_eve.account_code,ev_eve.currency currency_code, 0 as month_begin_debit_balance, 0 as month_begin_credit_balance, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as month_debit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as month_credit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as year_debit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as year_credit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as month_end_debit_balance, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as month_end_credit_balance
-- sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) month_debit_amount, sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) month_credit_amount from ev_eve join sub_ev on ev_eve.org_id = sub_ev.org_id and ev_eve.account_code = sub_ev.account_code and ev_eve.currency = sub_ev.currency_code and ev_eve.id >= sub_ev.min_id and ev_eve.id <= sub_ev.max_id join (select distinct account_code ,debit_credit_type from eg_account ea ) account on ev_eve.account_code = account.account_code group by ev_eve.org_id ,ev_eve.account_code,ev_eve.currency,account.debit_credit_type)

,res_voucher as( select ev_eve.contract_code ,ev_eve.org_id ,ev_eve.account_code , ev_eve.bill_contract_code,ev_eve.currency currency_code, -- sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) month_debit_amount, sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) month_credit_amount 0 as year_begin_debit_balance, 0 as year_begin_credit_balance, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as year_debit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as year_credit_amount, 0 as month_begin_debit_balance, 0 as month_begin_credit_balance, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as month_debit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as month_credit_amount, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'DR' then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else 0 end as month_end_debit_balance, case when account.debit_credit_type = 'CR' then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) - sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else 0 end as month_end_credit_balance from ev_eve join sub_ev on ev_eve.contract_code = sub_ev.contract_code and ev_eve.org_id = sub_ev.org_id and ev_eve.account_code = sub_ev.account_code and COALESCE(ev_eve.bill_contract_code,'') =COALESCE(sub_ev.bill_contract_code,'') and ev_eve.currency = sub_ev.currency_code and ev_eve.id >= sub_ev.min_id and ev_eve.id <= sub_ev.max_id join (select distinct account_code ,debit_credit_type from eg_account ea ) account on ev_eve.account_code = account.account_code group by ev_eve.contract_code ,ev_eve.org_id ,ev_eve.account_code ,ev_eve.bill_contract_code,ev_eve.currency,account.debit_credit_type)
mapper.select:
select * from res_account order by account_code
limit #{param.limit} offset #{param.offset}
mapper.sql: ,res_all as ( select coalesce(res_account.org_id,'') org_id, coalesce(res_account.account_code,'') account_code, coalesce(res_account.currency_code,'') currency_code, coalesce(res_account.month_begin_debit_balance,0) month_begin_debit_balance, coalesce(res_account.month_begin_credit_balance,0) month_begin_credit_balance, coalesce(res_account.month_debit_amount,0) month_debit_amount, coalesce(res_account.month_credit_amount,0) month_credit_amount, coalesce(res_account.year_debit_amount,0) year_debit_amount, coalesce(res_account.year_credit_amount,0) year_credit_amount, coalesce(res_account.month_end_debit_balance,0) month_end_debit_balance, coalesce(res_account.month_end_credit_balance,0) month_end_credit_balance from res_account union all select coalesce(res_voucher.org_id,'') org_id, coalesce(res_voucher.account_code,'') account_code, coalesce(res_voucher.currency_code,'') currency_code, coalesce(res_voucher.month_begin_debit_balance,0) month_begin_debit_balance, coalesce(res_voucher.month_begin_credit_balance,0) month_begin_credit_balance, coalesce(res_voucher.month_debit_amount,0) month_debit_amount, coalesce(res_voucher.month_credit_amount,0) month_credit_amount, coalesce(res_voucher.year_debit_amount,0) year_debit_amount, coalesce(res_voucher.year_credit_amount,0) year_credit_amount, coalesce(res_voucher.month_end_debit_balance,0) month_end_debit_balance, coalesce(res_voucher.month_end_credit_balance,0) month_end_credit_balance from res_voucher union all select coalesce(res_manual.org_id,'') org_id, coalesce(res_manual.account_code,'') account_code, coalesce(res_manual.currency_code,'') currency_code, coalesce(res_manual.month_begin_debit_balance,0) month_begin_debit_balance, coalesce(res_manual.month_begin_credit_balance,0) month_begin_credit_balance, coalesce(res_manual.month_debit_amount,0) month_debit_amount, coalesce(res_manual.month_credit_amount,0) month_credit_amount, coalesce(res_manual.year_debit_amount,0) year_debit_amount, coalesce(res_manual.year_credit_amount,0) year_credit_amount, coalesce(res_manual.month_end_debit_balance,0) month_end_debit_balance, coalesce(res_manual.month_end_credit_balance,0) month_end_credit_balance from res_manual) ,res_cal as ( select res_all.org_id,res_all.account_code,res_all.currency_code, sum(res_all.month_begin_debit_balance) month_begin_debit_balance, sum(res_all.month_begin_credit_balance) month_begin_credit_balance, sum(res_all.month_debit_amount) month_debit_amount, sum(res_all.month_credit_amount) month_credit_amount, sum(res_all.year_debit_amount) year_debit_amount, sum(res_all.year_credit_amount) year_credit_amount, sum(res_all.month_end_debit_balance) month_end_debit_balance, sum(res_all.month_end_credit_balance) month_end_credit_balance from res_all group by res_all.org_id, res_all.account_code, res_all.currency_code )

, account_metrics as ( select org_id, currency_code, account_code, max(account_name) account_name, sum(case when period_code < #{param.periodYearStart} then debit_amount - credit_amount else 0 end) year_begin_net, sum(case when period_code < #{param.periodCodeStart} then debit_amount - credit_amount else 0 end) month_begin_net, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodCodeStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then debit_amount else 0 end) month_debit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodCodeStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then credit_amount else 0 end) month_credit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodYearStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then debit_amount else 0 end) year_debit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodYearStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then credit_amount else 0 end) year_credit_amount, sum(debit_amount - credit_amount) month_end_net from ledger group by org_id, currency_code, account_code ), res_cal as ( select org_id, currency_code, account_code, account_name, greatest(year_begin_net, 0) year_begin_debit_balance, greatest(-year_begin_net, 0) year_begin_credit_balance, greatest(month_begin_net, 0) month_begin_debit_balance, greatest(-month_begin_net, 0) month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, greatest(month_end_net, 0) month_end_debit_balance, greatest(-month_end_net, 0) month_end_credit_balance from account_metrics where 1 = 1
and (month_debit_amount != 0 or month_credit_amount != 0)
and (month_debit_amount != 0 or month_credit_amount != 0 or month_end_net != 0)
and month_end_net != 0
and (year_debit_amount != 0 or year_credit_amount != 0)
and (month_end_net != 0 or year_debit_amount != 0 or year_credit_amount != 0)
)
mapper.select: with select count(1) total_size from res_cal
mapper.sql:
,res_all as ( select contract_code, org_id, account_code, bill_contract_code, currency_code, year_begin_debit_balance, year_begin_credit_balance, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, month_end_debit_balance, month_end_credit_balance from res_account union all select contract_code, org_id, account_code, bill_contract_code, currency_code, year_begin_debit_balance, year_begin_credit_balance, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, month_end_debit_balance, month_end_credit_balance from res_voucher union all select contract_code, org_id, account_code, bill_contract_code, currency_code, year_begin_debit_balance, year_begin_credit_balance, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, month_begin_debit_balance, month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, month_end_debit_balance, month_end_credit_balance from res_manual ) ,res_cal as ( select contract_code, org_id, account_code, bill_contract_code, currency_code, sum(coalesce(year_begin_debit_balance,0)) year_begin_debit_balance, sum(coalesce(year_begin_credit_balance,0)) year_begin_credit_balance, sum(coalesce(year_debit_amount,0)) year_debit_amount, sum(coalesce(year_credit_amount,0)) year_credit_amount, sum(coalesce(month_begin_debit_balance,0)) month_begin_debit_balance, sum(coalesce(month_begin_credit_balance,0)) month_begin_credit_balance, sum(coalesce(month_debit_amount,0)) month_debit_amount, sum(coalesce(month_credit_amount,0)) month_credit_amount, sum(coalesce(month_end_debit_balance,0)) month_end_debit_balance, sum(coalesce(month_end_credit_balance,0)) month_end_credit_balance from res_all group by contract_code, org_id, account_code, bill_contract_code, currency_code
)

, assist_metrics as ( select org_id, currency_code, account_code, max(account_name) account_name, coalesce(contract_code, '') contract_code, max(contract_name) contract_name, max(client_code) client_code, max(client_name) client_name, coalesce(bill_contract_code, '') bill_contract_code, sum(case when period_code < #{param.periodYearStart} then debit_amount - credit_amount else 0 end) year_begin_net, sum(case when period_code < #{param.periodCodeStart} then debit_amount - credit_amount else 0 end) month_begin_net, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodCodeStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then debit_amount else 0 end) month_debit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodCodeStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then credit_amount else 0 end) month_credit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodYearStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then debit_amount else 0 end) year_debit_amount, sum(case when period_code between #{param.periodYearStart} and #{param.periodCodeEnd} then credit_amount else 0 end) year_credit_amount, sum(debit_amount - credit_amount) month_end_net from ledger where contract_code is not null or bill_contract_code is not null group by org_id, currency_code, account_code, coalesce(contract_code, ''), coalesce(bill_contract_code, '') ), res_cal as ( select org_id, currency_code, account_code, account_name, contract_code, contract_name, client_code, client_name, bill_contract_code, greatest(year_begin_net, 0) year_begin_debit_balance, greatest(-year_begin_net, 0) year_begin_credit_balance, greatest(month_begin_net, 0) month_begin_debit_balance, greatest(-month_begin_net, 0) month_begin_credit_balance, month_debit_amount, month_credit_amount, year_debit_amount, year_credit_amount, greatest(month_end_net, 0) month_end_debit_balance, greatest(-month_end_net, 0) month_end_credit_balance from assist_metrics where 1 = 1
and (month_debit_amount != 0 or month_credit_amount != 0)
and (month_debit_amount != 0 or month_credit_amount != 0 or month_end_net != 0)
and month_end_net != 0
and (year_debit_amount != 0 or year_credit_amount != 0)
and (month_end_net != 0 or year_debit_amount != 0 or year_credit_amount != 0)
)
mapper.select: with select count(1) total_size from res_cal
